objective: Preallocate materialized CTE cleanup data prefixes from CTE-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate CTE data prefixes
tasks.result: Materialized CTE cleanup now uses an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<cte>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<cte>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in clear_materialized_cte data-prefix scan construction.
Generated prefix bytes, scan_prefix inputs, delete keys, and CTE query results are unchanged.
